notes: The posted registry results in doc_registry_NCT01179048.json were searched in outcomeMeasuresModule (all six measures), adverseEventsModule (seriousEvents, otherEvents, and event-group totals), and participantFlowModule. None reports adverse events leading to discontinuation. Drug withdrawal syndrome is a different outcome; serious-event totals and study noncompletion totals are also not this outcome. Source: Table 2, Any adverse event under Adverse event leading to permanent discontinuation of trial regimen; denominators and arm names are from the same table headers. Narrower discontinuation rows were not selected: serious adverse event (192 versus 245), severe adverse event (164 versus 188), nausea (77 versus 18), vomiting (31 versus 2), diarrhea (27 versus 5), increased lipase level (15 versus 11), abdominal pain (11 versus 3), decreased appetite (11 versus 2), and abdominal discomfort (10 versus 0), in liraglutide/placebo order. The overall adverse-event row (2909 versus 2839) is not restricted to discontinuation.
